context: The agent was asked to trace configuration flow across three layers: Terraform infrastructure, Flux platform services, and application manifests.

checklist.name: identifies_vpc_config
checklist.description: Correctly identifies VPC and subnet configuration from Terraform outputs or variables

checklist.name: finds_ingress_kustomization
checklist.description: Identifies which Kustomization deploys the ingress controller (ingress-nginx)

checklist.name: finds_app_namespace
checklist.description: Reports the namespace where applications are deployed

checklist.name: traces_ingress_connection
checklist.description: Explains how the application ingress connects to the platform ingress controller (via IngressClass or annotation)

checklist.name: scope_honesty
checklist.description: States what was omitted or truncated

checklist.name: evidence_quality
checklist.description: Cites real file paths from the provided evidence, no fabricated references
